Semantic modeling profile

Semantic foundation

Cross-source mapping · RDF · SPARQL · Data federation

Representation and interoperability

RDF mappings and SPARQL queries over supported source systems.

Updates and versioning

Maintain source mappings and model versions as part of the application lifecycle.

Limitations to check

A mapping and query capability, not automatic ontology learning. Source connectivity and mapping maintenance are required.

Build a meaningful sample

Test ambiguous terms, conflicting metric definitions, source mappings, and schema changes. Check how revisions affect the same workload.
